verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document a keyless or file-number entry path into CIPO's core online filing flow. The patents rail is described as running through a 'Log in to MyCIPO Patents' account. The trademark 'Apply for/amend' online service is listed without any statement that filing can start without an account. Keyless public patent search is a different capability from starting the filing flow, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
